summary: By T+131 ~18:35 Arlequino completed a day of street performances and festival promotion in Eurazania, earned 1g38s20c gross, transferred 13s82c to the family purse under the existing 10% rule, confirmed three outbound letters sent by Rena, and fixed key festival finance/public-access rules.
facts: Festival commercial revenue is to come from rent/fees charged to traders and similar commercial participants, not visitors.
Meira may plan festival expenses up to 10g; this is a cap, not a spending target.
Meira and Borga are authorized to coordinate festival/tournament spatial logistics directly.
Meira is authorized to advertise in Eurazania and invite trusted organizer contacts.
A T+132 morning finance meeting is planned at Arlequino's lodging; exact lodging name is known in-world from direct speech but UNKNOWN to GM.
Rena confirmed dispatch of three letters: Lissa in Blumund, the Queen in Blumund, and Каменная арка in Dwargon. Delivery remains UNKNOWN.
Arlequino publicly promoted the festival across several Eurazania-capital districts while performing only songs whose exact archived text is fully recoverable in GitHub.
Rena's guitar remains Rena's property and was temporarily used/carried by Arlequino with permission during the performances.
